rubric.confidence: conservative: electrostatic-stabiliser base confidence scaled by distance, then gated by the best co-located proton-transfer axis confidence
rubric.electrostatic_stabiliser: cationic (Arg/Lys) or His side chain, or backbone-amide/polar donor, contacting an anionic phosphate/carboxylate O (oxyanion stabilisation)
rubric.forbidden_inputs_used: none (no label, fingerprint, EC/Rhea, source text, curated role, or target name)
rubric.proton_transfer: His->metal/ring-redox (general acid/base), Asp/Glu->metal (base/water activator), Lys->PLP C4A (Schiff-base shuttle), Cys/Tyr->reactive atom

scope: DRAFT source-free proton-transfer / electrostatic-stabiliser event-axis linker rows for the 53 approved current702 heldout locators, produced by a deterministic label-blind structural rubric (residue identity + contacting atoms + distance + source-free role hints only). NOT gate-consumable: every row is pending reviewer sign-off. No locators copied, no heldout read, no threshold applied.
